notes.title: Bug Fix : Visit
notes.content:
Due to an oversight, Visit's boss battle had much more health than designed.
Health was reduced from 15000 to 5000.

notes.title: Endline Released Now!
notes.content:
4 years of solo development is a long time and such project was never expected to take that long. It was meant to be a small project taking a few months to do, but I underestimated severely how long it would take to get this far. I learned a lot along the way and will be using that knowledge to further my career. 

I don’t expect this to be a major success in terms of sales, but I thank everyone who’s willing to support this niche game. I gave my all and I hope you will enjoy it.

Endline is a bullet hell indie game focusing on a variety of play style and customization.
•	6 Playable ships
•	14 Stages
•	10 Usable abilities.
A special discount will be running for the launch week.

notes.title: Endline Demo Release + Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
[h1]Big news coming for Endline today.[/h1]

First is the release of the first gameplay trailer, showcasing a brand new level titled “The Ant and the Spider”.  A tease of what you can expect from the full game coming up in a few weeks.

[previewyoutube=jSUkCevn9BE;full][/previewyoutube]

Second is the demo release. Everybody can get a good sample for what the game has to offer with a choice of 2 playable ships and 3 stages.

The game demo is available for both Windows and Linux users.
Enjoy
